title: Kanojo no Tomodachi
synopsis:
High school student Takeru Hidaka has recently started dating his classmate Kaori Koga. While the two agree to take their relationship slowly, he has an issue: Tomoko Yoshioka, Kaori's best friend. Yoshioka is willing to do anything to get Takeru to cheat on Kaori with her, as that is the only thing that could satisfy her sexually.

Despite Yoshioka's persistent advances, Takeru wants to stay loyal to Kaori. But as Yoshioka ramps up her attempts at seduction and manipulation, Takeru's faithfulness is truly put to the test.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
